buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) FOR GOODS TR ANSPORT SERVICE 1. Price Bid Breakdown Structure (Slab-wise Rates): · This bid is invited on a Custom Bid Model for Goods Transport Service from any location to any lo cation in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana State based on distance. · The bidder must mandatorily provide a detailed price break-up according to the 4 Distance Slabs as specified in the uploaded Excel Template. · The 4 Slabs and their approx Indicative Quantities are defined as follows: o Slab 1: >100 KM up to 200 KM (Indicative Qty: 12,000 MT) o Slab 2: >200 KM up to 350 KM (Indicative Qty: 12,000 MT) o Slab 3: >350 KM up to 500 KM (Indicative Qty: 12,000 MT) o Slab 4: >500 KM (Indicative Qty: 12,000 MT) 2. Basic Rate Criteria (Excluding GST): · All unit rates quoted by the bidder in Column E (Unit Rate (Rs.) - Per MT Per KM) must be strictly exc lusive of GST (Base Price Only). · Applicable GST percentage must be selected by the bidder separately on the GeM portal as per stand ard GeM guidelines. Any inclusion of GST within the Excel sheet unit rates will lead to immediate com mercial rejection of the bid. 3. Mandatory Submission & Formula Matching: · It is mandatory for all participating bidders to download the provided Excel format, fill in their respe ctive Unit Rates for all 4 slabs in Column E, and upload the completed file in the Financial Document / Excel Upload section. · The calculation formula for each slab row must be followed as Total Amount per KM (Rs.) = Indica tive qty (MT) * Unit Rate (Rs.) (Column F = D * E).

· The Grand Total calculated at the bottom of the uploaded Excel sheet must exactly match the total l ump-sum price quoted by the bidder on the GeM Portal dashboard. In case of any mathematical mism atch, the buyer reserves the right to take appropriate action including rejection. 4. Disqualification Criteria: · Bidders who fail to upload this slab-wise price break-up document or leave any slab rate blank/zero in Column E will be treated as non-responsive and will be technically/financially disqualified without any further clarification. 5. Other Terms and Conditions: · Only Empaneled Transporters are eligible to participate in the Bidding and Reverse Aucti on. · Lifting reports, vehicle wise should be sent to the issuing branch by the transporter on weekly basis through email. Transporter should ensure MTC along with the consignment. · Transporters are required to go through Scope of Work. .
